parts.title: Task 2
parts.article:
Writing

You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write about the following topic: Some people argue that primary schools focus too much on formal learning. To what extent do you agree with this opinion? How important do you think it is for children to play as well as learn in the primary school classroom? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
